summary: The proposed patch modifies the behavior of autodoc_docstring_signature to handle multiple signatures from docstrings, which addresses the issue of overloaded methods. However, it changes the return type from a single tuple to a list of tuples, which may require adjustments in other parts of the codebase.

issues.description: Changing the return type of autodoc_docstring_signature from a single tuple to a list of tuples could introduce behavioral regressions if other parts of the codebase expect a single tuple. This requires careful review to ensure no existing functionality is broken.
